name: drovr
description: Capacity-aware supervisor for long-horizon autonomous delivery loops

scripts.build:lambda: esbuild lambda/hey-mcp/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=lambda/hey-mcp/dist/index.mjs && esbuild lambda/hey-mcp-edge/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=lambda/hey-mcp-edge/dist/index.js
scripts.test:cli: cd cli/hey && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go test ./... && if command -v staticcheck >/dev/null; then staticcheck ./...; fi
